sentences.l2: 在很多地方，人们喜欢讲故事。
sentences.l1: In many places, people like to tell stories.

sentences.l2: 故事可以是古代的事，也可以是假的。
sentences.l1: A story can be about ancient times, or it can be made up.

sentences.l2: 老人经常讲民间传说，年轻人听。
sentences.l1: Old people often tell folk tales, and young people listen.

sentences.l2: 这样，大家就知道以前的事了。
sentences.l1: In this way, everyone comes to know about things in the past.

sentences.l2: 讲故事是口头传统，不用书本。
sentences.l1: Telling stories is an oral tradition and does not need books.

sentences.l2: 人们用说话来交流想法和历史。
sentences.l1: People use speaking to exchange ideas and history.

sentences.l2: 每个村、每个国家都有自己的叙事方式。
sentences.l1: Every village and every country has its own way of narrative.

sentences.l2: 有的地方打鼓讲故事，有的地方跳舞讲故事。
sentences.l1: In some places they beat drums to tell stories, and in other places they dance to tell stories.

sentences.l2: 故事可以教人做对的事，也可以让人开心。
sentences.l1: Stories can teach people to do what is right, and can also make people happy.

sentences.l2: 小朋友听故事，学会听和说。
sentences.l1: Children listen to stories and learn to listen and speak.

sentences.l2: 家人一起讲故事，关系也会更好。
sentences.l1: When family members tell stories together, their relationships also get better.

sentences.l2: 现在，有些人用手机讲，但面对面讲故事更温暖。
sentences.l1: Nowadays, some people tell them using mobile phones, but telling stories face to face is warmer.

sentences.l2: 讲故事是一种快乐的交流方式。
sentences.l1: Telling stories is a happy way of communicating.

sentences.l2: 我们都要学会听故事和讲故事。
sentences.l1: We should all learn to listen to stories and tell stories.
